title: vibeflow as first event source
description: Emit events in the ADR-0001 envelope from vibeflow per docs/integrations/vibeflow.md: source, event, message and metadata, severity left unset unless vibeflow genuinely knows it. One-directional and dumb on the vibeflow side; the caretaker never reads vibeflow storage or credentials. Round-trip every emitted envelope against eventEnvelopeSchema.
author: Tomislav Zorcec
